name: Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun®
short_description: The Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is a 21.1km, 10km, and 5km race held on October 31, 2026, in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is scheduled for October 31, 2026, in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia, starting at the Drawbridge venue. Organized by JomRun, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runners from casual participants to half marathon enthusiasts. Registration for the race is currently open, allowing interested runners to secure their spot ahead of the event date.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) to suit different runner levels
Organized by JomRun, a named event organizer
Located at a specific, identifiable venue: Drawbridge, Kuala Terengganu

research_highlights: Course centers on the Kuala Terengganu Drawbridge (Jambatan Angkat), with the bridge raised and lowered just before flag-off as a signature moment of the event, before runners head out along Miami Beach toward Sultan Mahmud Airport and back.
The 2025 edition's race village/bib collection was held at 'Tapak C Drawbridge, Kuala Terengganu' with an 11:00 AM–6:00 PM window, per JomRun's event page.

Entitlements for the 21.1KM category include an event jersey, finisher medal, a separate finisher jersey (for half-marathon finishers only), an RFID-timed bib, e-certificate and light refreshments, while 5KM/10KM bibs are untimed.

The race is part of JomRun's 10-city 'JomRun Half Marathon Series – Malaysia', run across the year (Kuching, Bintulu, Johor Bahru, Cybercity, Kuantan, Kota Kinabalu, Seremban, Terengganu, Rawang, Georgetown), so logistics/format closely mirror JomRun's other city half marathons.
research_watchouts: As of mid-2026, JomRun's own listing for the 2026 edition still showed 'Date: To Be Confirmed, Time: To Be Confirmed, Venue: To Be Confirmed' for detailed race-day logistics, so participants should double-check final start time/venue closer to race day rather than relying on early registration pages.

No independent English-language race reports, forum threads, or news coverage discussing organisation quality, heat conditions, or crowd support for this specific event were found beyond one short personal recap and organizer/promotional listings — so claims about atmosphere, cut-off times, or on-course support could not be verified from participant sources.

faqs.question: When is the Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is scheduled to take place on October 31, 2026. The event will be held in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia, at the Drawbridge venue, giving runners a specific date to plan their travel and training around.

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance categories at this event: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range of options allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to take part in the same event.

faqs.question: Is registration currently available for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® is currently open. Interested runners can sign up now to secure their place in one of the three available distance categories before the event takes place on October 31, 2026.

faqs.question: Where is the race located?
faqs.answer: The race is held in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia, with the starting point at the Drawbridge venue. This location serves as the hub for all three distance categories offered during the Terengganu Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun®.
